definition: A qualifying event is an official issuer announcement that either cuts full-year earnings guidance or quantifies a material prospective adverse impact on profit. Routine earnings misses, unquantified caution, and reductions to operating metrics without a clear profit implication are excluded.

events.metric: Adjusted profit before tax at constant currency
events.summary: Computacenter revised its FY24 adjusted profit outlook from further progress to modestly behind the prior year after a softer end to the third quarter.
drivers: Softer-than-anticipated end to the third quarter

events.metric: Group adjusted profit before tax and amortisation
events.summary: Rentokil revised its FY24 profit outlook after weaker North American trading and integration disruption, with additional cost and currency headwinds.
drivers: Lower-than-anticipated July and August trading in North America
Branch integration disruption and associated operating costs

events.metric: Operating profit before mitigation, insurance and trading actions
events.summary: Marks & Spencer quantified an expected £300m operating-profit impact from its cyber incident before mitigation, insurance and trading actions.
Kingfisher reduced FY23/24 adjusted profit guidance after a difficult first half, with particular weakness in Poland and volatile weather.

events.previousGuidance: Prior revenue guidance and market operating-profit expectations
events.revisedGuidance: Lower end of the then-current £552m-£668m consensus range if weaker demand persisted
events.summary: Burberry warned that weaker luxury demand made its prior FY24 revenue guidance unlikely and would place adjusted operating profit toward the lower end of consensus.

events.previousGuidance: Lower end of the then-current £552m-£668m consensus range
events.summary: Burberry reduced FY24 adjusted operating-profit guidance to £410m-£460m as the slowdown in luxury demand continued to affect trading.

events.previousGuidance: Market consensus for FY25 operating profit
events.revisedGuidance: Below consensus, with a first-half operating loss if the Q1 trend persisted
events.summary: Burberry warned that continued weak trading could produce a first-half operating loss and FY25 operating profit below consensus, and suspended FY25 dividends.
drivers: 21% decline in first-quarter comparable store sales

events.summary: Croda reduced FY23 Group adjusted profit before tax guidance after continued customer destocking and weaker Crop Protection and industrial demand.

events.previousGuidance: Gradual improvement from the second half of FY23
events.revisedGuidance: A decline compared with the first half of FY23
events.summary: Diageo reversed its first-half organic operating-profit growth outlook after a materially weaker performance forecast in Latin America and the Caribbean.
drivers: More than 20% expected organic sales decline in Latin America and the Caribbean
Lower operating leverage and adverse mix

events.revisedGuidance: Range retained, with approximately £45m adverse October EBITDA impact disclosed
events.summary: Entain quantified an approximately £45m October EBITDA impact from customer-friendly sports results while retaining its full-year guidance range.

events.previousGuidance: Operating margin in line with 8.3% achieved in 2024
events.summary: Bunzl reduced its FY25 operating-margin guidance after first-quarter adjusted operating profit fell significantly amid North American and Continental European weakness.
drivers: North American revenue softness and execution challenges
